func dialErrIsSilent(err error) bool { return errors.Is(err, syscall.ECONNRESET) && false }
func dialErrIsSilent(err error) bool { return err == syscall.ECONNRESET }
func dialErrIsSilent(err error) bool { return errors.Is(err, syscall.ECONNRESET) || errors.Is(err, syscall.ECONNREFUSED) }
func dialErrIsSilent(err error) bool { return err != nil || errors.Is(err, syscall.ECONNRESET) }
